notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to reconcile, in priority order: (1) TIMING — Heat Emission (dump, Reload Ratio ▼, team 38.96/48.4) keys to Prediction END = burstCast+10s; the engine has no status-end trigger, so watch for the whole block being hung off burstCast (t=cast) or modeled as a fight-long passive — both over-credit, and a passive additionally accelerates the FIRST rotation (assert time-to-first-FB unchanged). (2) 'Reload Ratio ▼ 50%' is a weapon-state DAMAGE line, not defensive QoL — the single most drop-prone line in this kit; under the refill-fraction reading it also PROTECTS Overheat I from its own removeOnReload (reload never reaches max), a whole-picture interaction the driver must rule on explicitly. It has no schema primitive (reloadSpeedPct is speed, not refill) — expect a flagged approximation, not silence. (3) The 'under certain conditions' Heat Emission removal is measurement-gated and load-bearing twice over: it sets the team block's uptime AND decides whether skill1's 48.4% pierce can ever stack onto her own Prediction (48.4+52.8+39.98 vs never) — any encoding that lets it overlap must carry a ⚑ ruling. (4) Overheat II/III say 'continuously' with no removal clause → permanent once earned; nearest-wrong is dying with the 10s Prediction or inheriting removeOnReload. Overheat III is attackDamagePct, not atkPct. (5) Burst '▲ 3 round(s) for 10 sec': rounds is the MAGNITUDE (maxAmmoFlat 3), seconds is the duration — do not let 'round(s)' pattern-match into durationShots. (6) Both pierceDamagePct lines are live ONLY on pierce-tagged attackers — the stale 'inert in v1' StatKey comment must not justify dropping them, and conversely they must NOT move non-pierce teammates (inertness assertion). (7) Burst is burstCast (own B2 cast), not fullBurstEnter. (8) The forced reload after the ammo dump is the intended Overheat-I reset valve — its presence/absence visibly changes the atkPct 15.48 re-earn cadence; assert the reload event at cast+10s+ε. Counter ambiguity (per-Prediction reset vs cumulative) is steady-state inert at 120 landings/window but should be documented.
